name: Sebastian Lopez
education: Mechanical Engineering, University of California, Berkeley
about: Hey! I'm studying Mechanical Engineering at Cal, with an intended minor in Structural Engineering, and I am passionate about applying myself and my knowledge to derive solutions that have real impact. I enjoy working on projects that utilize CAD, FEA, embedded systems, and physical testing.

experience.title: Mechanical Design Engineer — ClearPath Medical
bullets: Initiated development of scalable in-house connector platform to reduce supplier reliance and procurement lead times.
Designed high-voltage connector platform with IEC 60601 and MOOP compliance for medical protection standards.
Performed conceptual design and detailed analysis addressing high-voltage creepage and clearance safety challenges.
Researched advanced composite material solutions to improve overall electrical insulation and prevent conductor arcing.
Evaluated scalability in pin count and optimized for compact low-voltage and transient high-voltage surge applications.

experience.title: Civil Engineering Intern — PGH Wong Engineering
bullets: Contributed to rail alignment optimization following scope reduction from Mountain House terminus, analyzing alternative pathways and Z-curve configuration at Vasco intersection to efficiently connect with existing ACE railway station.

Developed parcel inventory from Alameda county assessor data including ownership details, public/private classifications, and footprint calculations by easement type to support RoW acquisition and preliminary engineering documentation.

Assisted in developing highway connection layouts for the Livermore–Vasco corridor, mapping Right-of-Way exhibit strategies and defining aerial easement pathing for the freeway breakaway section initiating the Z-curve to the station.

experience.title: HS Explainer — The Exploratorium
bullets: Performed 10 unique science demonstrations engaging visitors and museum guests across a range of scientific fields.
Trained around 30 incoming High School Explainers every semester on museum operations and scientific demonstrations.
Facilitated over 1000 visitor interactions daily across 600 exhibits/coordinated with a team of 30+ explainers per shift.
Utilized a museum-wide radio system to assist with general operations, such as reuniting lost visitors with their families.
Participated in daily career development training (200+ hours), advancing skills in public speaking and leadership.

experience.title: Civil Engineering & Design Intern — PGH Wong Engineering
bullets: Partnered with 80+ engineers on $2.6B SFO Terminal 3 expansion/modernization, increasing terminal capacity by 30%.
Developed phasing/sequencing procedures during construction and minimizing disruptions in active zones by over 50%.
Executed installments of temporary walkways and refined passenger routing strategies to maintain operational efficiency.
Honed skills in construction operations, project management, and budget oversight for a large-scale infrastructure project.
